target: an artifact, by locator (may refine below a file)
scope: artifacts the registry curates; authoritative for what it covers, undeclared is a normal state
title: Content classification
gloss: What each artifact is epistemically: supplied source material, mechanical output, or authored analysis, and which corpora it belongs to.

scope: every CSV returned by git ls-files in this repository
title: CSV census
gloss: Every tracked CSV in this repository, with physical measurements and source headers.

scope: every .md, .json and .csv file under docs/, the three extensions node/test/docs-registry.test.mjs walks; docs/examples/, docs/prototypes/ and docs/favicons/ hold other files, out of scope and deliberately so
title: Documentation inventory
gloss: Every document under docs/, what it is about, whether it is kept true, and who can reach it.

scope: every executable the repo runs on itself: node/ and python/ (node/test/ excluded; the Tests registry owns it), .githooks/, .claude/, the plugin hook bundle at skills/hooks/, and .github/workflows/
title: Harness inventory
gloss: Every code file under node/ and python/, what it is for, how it is invoked, and whether prose names it or a test exercises it.

target: a step of the commit hook
scope: every `# --- leg` section of .githooks/pre-commit, in the order the hook runs them
title: Commit-hook steps
gloss: Every step of the commit hook: the paths it watches, what it runs, the files it regenerates or only warns about, and whether the repair pass on main runs it.

scope: every .js file directly under lib/kits/, the logic shelf docs/code-layers.md admits by attachment alone; demos and subfolders are pages, owned by the pages registry
title: Kit shelf
gloss: Every logic module on the kit shelf: its namespace, the sentence its own header opens with, whether every page pays for it at boot, whether a demo exists, and how many files load it.

scope: every key in use across the estate's repo manifests, INCLUDING the members of an array or object key, addressed pages[].path or stage.files. Those were nested inside their parent rows until 2026-08-16, so the registry counted 20 while its scope claimed 46
title: Manifest field vocabulary
gloss: Every key a repo's .web-tools.json may carry, what it means, which tool reads it, and whether a member is required

scope: every .html page under pages/ except the gallery page itself, one row each; the group the page sits in rides on the row as two columns rather than nesting it
title: Page gallery
gloss: Every HTML page under pages/, grouped, with the title and thumbnail the gallery and picker show.

scope: files curated to travel to other repos; an authored selection crosswalk over the registries that own each target, so intrinsic description is inherited rather than restated
title: Distribution
gloss: The crosswalk of files that travel to other repos, how each one travels, and which primary inventory owns it.

scope: the ways toss-render.html is handed a payload or a reference, and the trust posture each buys
title: Delivery modes
gloss: How a tossed payload travels, and the trust and sandbox posture each mode carries.

scope: the content types that map to a renderer page; owner of toss-render.html's inlined TOSS_ROUTES literal
title: Renderer dispatch table
gloss: Every route toss-render accepts, what each one addresses, and which viewer it opens.

scope: what a subject IS, one level under the showing frame's subject axis: how it is recognized, the viewer mode it opens in, the route that addresses it, and the units a note can be pinned to inside it. Owner of ViewRegistry.KIND_VIEW and of kits/md-doc.js's declared KIND literal
title: Content kinds
gloss: What each kind of content is, how it is recognized, what opens it, and what a note can aim at inside it.

scope: the links that can show a change, what each reaches and misses; rendered as the Map view Showing tab
title: Showing mechanisms
gloss: Which link reaches which kind of change, and what each one silently misses.

target: a surface that takes a paste
scope: what a pasted thing becomes on each surface that reads the clipboard, and what each declines to; the address grammar read backwards, where every other routes registry is about minting one
title: Paste behavior
gloss: What a paste becomes on each surface that reads the clipboard, and where the ones that route decline to.

scope: every directory under skills/
title: Skill roster
gloss: The skills this repo ships, each carrying the trigger description its own SKILL.md owns.

scope: every directory under archive/skills/
title: Skill archive
gloss: Retired skills created or adapted here: when each left the roster, why, and the file that now carries its guidance.

scope: every .mjs under node/test/ except the declared shared helpers
title: Test coverage map
gloss: Every test file in the suite, with its test count, test names, method and runner.

scope: the files docs/tests.csv lists, one row each
title: Authored test columns
gloss: Whether each test checks behavior or is a gate, and what breaks if it is deleted.

scope: the names a prose-bearing CSV column or JSON key may carry, estate-wide; portable, since a concept named once should be the same concept in every repo
title: Prose field vocabulary
gloss: The sanctioned names for a prose-bearing field, so one concept is not called four things across four files.

scope: the pages the Tools view shows; a crosswalk over pages, which owns each page's title and description. Every bare hub path must resolve to a row in pages/pages.csv
title: Tools gallery
gloss: The authored selection of pages the Tools view shows, and the icon each is given; a crosswalk over the page gallery.

scope: every task file under tracker/tasks/
title: Tracker board
gloss: Every task in the project tracker, its state, size, and activity, derived from the task files.

target: an open tag on a tracker task
scope: every frontmatter key a task file carries that the generator does not recognize, one row per pair. The second grain of the same source: TRACKER.md keeps the tag layer open, so it cannot be columns, and a CSV holds one table
title: Tracker open tags
gloss: The unrecognized frontmatter a task carries, preserved so a consumer can select on it before the generator learns it.

scope: the ?view= keys app/index.html's VIEWS table dispatches, and for each the files that render it and the derived caches it consumes; not toss routes, which are a content type mapped to a renderer page and answer to routes-routes, and not pages, which pages/pages.csv owns: app/index.html carries every route in this table, so a routed view is a destination inside one page rather than a page of its own, subtracted here the way harness subtracts node/test/
title: App route inventory
gloss: Every destination the Web Tools app can be sent to, what it is for, which files draw it, and which of the estate's derived caches it reads.

scope: what is on screen, typed: the showing frame's subject axis promoted from docs/routes.json and extended with the estate's own objects (estate, project, branch, session). routes-kinds and showing-mechanisms key their `subject` columns into it; the FAB derives a layer's type from the address against the same detect rules and takes its glyph from `icon`
title: Object types
gloss: What is on screen, by type: what carries each object, how the address gives it away, and the glyph it wears.

scope: registries the estate declares. Curated, not computed: no rule decides whether a file is a registry, which is why this table missed itself
title: Registries
gloss: every registry the estate declares: where it lives, what it asserts about, and what holds it

target: a property one registry records about its targets
scope: every column of every registry in registries.csv, except each registry's key, which is the row's identity rather than a fact about it
title: Properties
gloss: every column of every registry: what it means, how it arises, and what it may hold

target: one value of one closed domain
scope: every value of every closed domain declared in properties.csv that is worth a gloss; a domain whose values speak for themselves needs no rows
title: Value glosses
gloss: what each value of a closed domain means, which the domain column itself cannot carry

target: a durable goal of the estate
scope: the goals docs/aims.json framed until 2026-09-09; the mission sentence stays there
title: Aims: goals
gloss: The five goals the estate’s material is held to.

target: a document on the guided reading list
scope: the ordered reading paths Overview/Purpose offers a new reader
title: Overview/Purpose: reading list
gloss: The guided entry into the estate’s self-description.

target: a pair of markdown files sharing repeated prose
scope: every tracked .md outside the excluded prefixes, paired when they share at least the floor of 10-word windows
title: Duplication graph
gloss: The measured edges the Themes tab clusters.

target: one glob of a named retrieval source
scope: the corpus corpus_search.py scans; a repo adopting the skill edits its own copy
title: Retrieval sources
gloss: Where documentation and code live, as named glob sets the retrieval tool reads.

target: a branch, by repo and name
scope: branches whose author is declared by a row rather than read off a prefix or trailer; undeclared is a normal state and classifies as unknown
title: Declared branch authorship
gloss: Which assistant or person authored a branch that carries no prefix or trailer, and the basis for the claim.

target: a strategic initiative of the estate
scope: the five strategic initiatives connecting our goals to active work
title: Aims: initiatives
gloss: The five strategic initiatives connecting our goals to active work.

target: a method of running an errand's script
scope: the ways a person runs an errand's code, which venues each allows and how its output returns; owner of kits/errands.js's METHODS literal
title: Errand run methods
gloss: How a person runs an errand's script, where it may run, and how its output comes back.

scope: every program that makes a commit or moves a branch in an estate repository: what starts it, the machine it runs on, where it sets and how; two writers differ by program, machine or kind; rendered as the Map view Set tab
title: Writers
gloss: Every program that can commit to an estate repository, what starts it, the machine it runs on, and where and how it sets.

scope: the ?tab= keys the shell's MAP_TABS and MAP_SUBVIEWS accept, one row each; the tab labels, icons and nesting stay in map.js's TABS and SUBVIEWS arrays, which the strip is generated from
title: Map tab descriptions
gloss: Every Map view address, the one sentence that says what its rows are (listed together in the Overview and opening its own Sources and methods panel), the files that sentence links to, and a longer account of what that tab shows.

scope: the public half of what enters a Claude Code session in this estate: the plugin's package, skills and hooks, web-tools' own instruction and settings files, and the session's own channels; the private half (account, environment, user scope, and the private repos) is the same schema in web-tools-private environment/context-sources.csv
title: Context sources
gloss: Everything that enters a session: where it is defined, how and when it arrives, whether a session can read or change it, and how we know it arrived.

scope: the subjects that more than one context source speaks to, each with a verdict on whether the overlap is layered by design, redundant, conflicting, or transitional
title: Context overlaps
gloss: Where two or more context sources say the same thing, and whether that is by design.

scope: every event Claude Code accepts a hook on, as the installed CLI lists them, with the summary its /hooks menu gives; copied from Claude Code 2.1.304, so a new release can add events this table lacks
title: Claude Code hook events
gloss: Every point in a Claude Code session where a hook can run, and when each one fires.

target: a markdown file the overlap scan read
scope: the shingle scan's eligible set (every tracked .md outside its excluded prefixes and record-status docs), as of the scan's last run
title: Overlap scan: files
gloss: Each file the passage-embedding scan read, with the hash its offsets belong to and the word and shingle counts its shares divide by.

target: a passage and its best match in one other file
scope: every prose passage of every scanned file, paired with each other scanned file where its best-matching passage there scores at least cosine 0.75
title: Overlap scan: passage matches
gloss: Passages whose embeddings sit close to a passage in another file, as source offsets; the Themes tab's Related lens cuts the text from the files.

scope: a seeded, stratified sample of the passage pairs in data/doc-overlap/matches.csv, labelled by a reader agent and reviewed by a skeptic agent; precious, never regenerated
title: Overlap scan: gold set
gloss: Hand-labelled passage pairs that score the Related lens's cosine cutoff: what each pair is, and whether it is worth reading or consolidating.

target: a topic of the policy catalog
scope: the topics that group the rules in docs/policies.csv, each under one of six areas; the tree the Policy tab's rail draws
title: Policy topics
gloss: The topics the catalog's rules are grouped by, each under an area.

scope: rules distilled from web-tools' living docs and governance skills, each with the passage that states it and, where known, who set it
title: Policy catalog
gloss: The rules the documentation settles, one sentence each, with the passage each rests on.

target: an outpost: a place outside git that holds estate material no commit can write
scope: every place the estate keeps material it cannot reach by commit and checks on: the work computer's PowerShell, the phone's Shortcuts library, the cloud environment settings, and the claude.ai account's skills
title: Outposts
gloss: Each place outside git that holds estate material: what declares its contents, how its state is observed and by whom, the check, and the fix.

target: a skill the claude.ai account holds or should hold
scope: every skill on the claude.ai account when it was last observed, and any declared for it since
title: Account skills
gloss: What the claude.ai account should hold: each skill on or off, and the plugin skill an upload or vendored copy should match.

target: an outside skill: one written elsewhere that this estate watches, studies, holds or copies
scope: every outside skill the estate has noted, from one only watched to one copied into skills/, and any it declined
title: Upstream skills
gloss: Skills written elsewhere that the estate follows: where each lives, the version pinned, why it is of interest, and our copy if there is one.

target: an agent the hub ships or spawns
scope: every Claude Code agent definition the portable plugin ships under skills/agents/, and every reader role a hub skill spawns through the Agent tool with its prompt written into the skill. Another repo's own agents are not rows here: each repo declares them in its .web-tools.json `agents` key and the Map reads them through the crawl
title: Agent roster
gloss: Every agent the hub ships as a definition file or spawns as a reader inside a skill: which kind, what model and tools it runs with, and what it does.

target: a pet peeve: a correction the owner has made to an assistant repeatedly
scope: every recurring correction in the owner's recorded session prompts (web-tools-private sessions/, 2026-08 onward) that names a behavior a reviewer can check. The quotes behind each row stay in web-tools-private
title: Pet peeves
gloss: The owner's recurring corrections as a checkable list: the behavior, what tripping it looks like, the document that already states it, and what catches it.

scope: authored delivery relationships between public Context sources; hook registration is derived separately from hooks.json
title: Context connections
gloss: Which source installs or invokes another and the conditions on that connection.

scope: every tracked .html, .js, .mjs and .css file python/css-blocks.py walks that carries unexempt declarations; a file carrying none has no row
title: CSS baseline
gloss: The most unexempt hand-written CSS declarations each file may carry: a ratchet that conversion to utilities lowers and nothing raises.

target: a thing you might want done that raises where to do it
scope: what a person might want done, each as the path through the Set diagram that does it: what starts it, the writers that carry it in order, and where it lands; the writers it names are described by the writers registry
title: Intents
gloss: What you might want done, each as a path through the Set diagram from what starts it to where it lands.

scope: the rules CONVERSATION.md defines. The PROSE stays authoritative and this is its gated index, so ownership runs opposite to every other registry here; declaring its fields governs the INDEX, not the definitions
title: Conversation rules
gloss: The gated index of CONVERSATION.md’s rules, the prose staying authoritative.

scope: each set of icons the estate has settled on, the file that declares its members, and the passage that discusses them; rendered as the Map view Overview tab's Icons
title: Icon families
gloss: Where the estate has established icons, and where each family is discussed.
